cases.definition_yaml:
name: node-kind-command
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-command.
nodes:
  - id: command-node
    command: review

name: node-kind-prompt
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-prompt.
nodes:
  - id: prompt-node
    prompt: Review the input.

name: node-kind-bash
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-bash.
nodes:
  - id: bash-node
    bash: printf ok

name: node-kind-script
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-script.
nodes:
  - id: script-node
    script: |
      print('ok')
    runtime: uv

name: node-kind-loop
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-loop.
nodes:
  - id: loop-node
    loop:
      prompt: Try again.
      until: done
      max_iterations: 2

name: node-kind-approval
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-approval.
nodes:
  - id: approval-node
    approval:
      message: Continue?

name: node-kind-cancel
description: Conformance fixture for node-kind-cancel.
nodes:
  - id: cancel-node
    cancel: Stop the workflow.

cases.companion_yaml:
language_compatibility: archon-2026-07
required_services: [git]
tags: [conformance]
outward_action_nodes: [prepare]
outward_action_policy: approval_required
overlap_policy: queue
pause_lane_policy: hold
required_secrets: [FIXTURE_TOKEN]
cases.definition_yaml:
name: field-families
description: Conformance fixture for field-families.
provider: openrouter
model: small
modelReasoningEffort: high
webSearchMode: auto
interactive: false
requires: [git]
worktree: {enabled: false}
tags: [conformance]
persist_sessions: false
effort: high
thinking: adaptive
fallbackModel: medium
betas: [fixture]
sandbox: {enabled: false}
nodes:
  - id: prepare
    prompt: Prepare.
    retry: {max_attempts: 1, delay_ms: 1000, on_error: transient}
    provider: openrouter
    model: small
    allowed_tools: [read_file]
    denied_tools: [terminal]
    skills: [review]
    agents:
      reviewer:
        description: Review the result.
        prompt: Check the result.
        model: medium
        tools: [read_file]
        disallowedTools: [terminal]
        skills: [review]
        maxTurns: 2
    hooks:
      PreToolUse:
        - matcher: ^read_file$
          timeout: 30
          response:
            continue: true
            systemMessage: Keep the operation bounded.
            hookSpecificOutput:
              hookEventName: PreToolUse
              permissionDecision: allow
              permissionDecisionReason: Fixture policy.
              updatedInput: {path: safe.txt}
              additionalContext: Fixture context.
  - id: repeat
    loop:
      prompt: Try again.
      until: done
      max_iterations: 2
  - id: approve
    approval:
      message: Continue?
      capture_response: true
      on_reject:
        prompt: Revise.
        max_attempts: 2
  - id: finish
    depends_on: [prepare, repeat, approve]
    bash: printf done
    trigger_rule: all_done
    context: fresh
    always_run: true
    timeout: 1000
    artifacts: true

name: loop-group-minimal
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-minimal.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: work
          prompt: Work.

name: loop-group-all-body-kinds
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-all-body-kinds.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: command
          command: review
        - id: prompt
          prompt: Work.
        - id: bash
          bash: printf ok
        - id: script
          script: |
            print('ok')
          runtime: uv
        - id: loop
          loop:
            prompt: Retry.
            until: done
            max_iterations: 1
        - id: approval
          approval:
            message: Continue?
        - id: cancel
          cancel: Stop.

name: loop-group-empty
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-empty.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        []

name: loop-group-duplicate-id
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-duplicate-id.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: same
          prompt: One.
        - id: same
          prompt: Two.

name: loop-group-missing-dependency
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-missing-dependency.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: consumer
          depends_on: [missing]
          prompt: Consume.

name: loop-group-self-edge
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-self-edge.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: self
          depends_on: [self]
          prompt: Consume.

name: loop-group-cycle
description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-cycle.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: one
          depends_on: [two]
          prompt: One.
        - id: two

description: Conformance fixture for loop-group-multimode-scopes-valid.
nodes:
  - id: outer
    prompt: Produce outer.
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      until_bash: test "$producer.output|$outer.output|$LOOP_PREV.producer.output" = ready
      gate_message: Gate $outer.output
      nodes:
        - id: producer
          prompt: Produce.
        - id: text
          depends_on: [producer]
          prompt: Text $producer.output $outer.output $LOOP_PREV.producer.output
          when: $producer.output == 'ready'
          systemPrompt: System $outer.output
          agents:
            reviewer:
              description: Describe $producer.output
              prompt: Review $LOOP_PREV.producer.output
          hooks:
            PreToolUse:
              - response:
                  systemMessage: System $producer.output
                  hookSpecificOutput:
                    hookEventName: PreToolUse
                    additionalContext: Context $outer.output
        - id: shell
          depends_on: [producer]
          bash: test "$producer.output|$outer.output|$LOOP_PREV.producer.output" = ready
        - id: inline
          depends_on: [producer]
          script: print('$producer.output', '$outer.output', '$LOOP_PREV.producer.output')
          runtime: uv
        - id: repeat
